topic.readerProblem: Buyers who find LLMrefs' single capped plan, weekly refresh or keyword-first design a poor fit need alternatives with verified entry prices matched to their reason for leaving.
topic.connection: AEOeye's free ChatGPT audit and $29 one-time report serve the baseline job; the page routes readers needing daily tracking or a managed platform to Otterly, Peec AI, Nightwatch, AthenaHQ or Profound, and says when LLMrefs is still right.

assessment: The page replaces an older alternatives list that relied on a third-party review's scores and on outdated competitor prices (Otterly Premium, Peec EUR 89, Profound $499, Nightwatch $32 + AI add-on). It derives the reasons to leave from LLMrefs' own pages and compares entry prices read from each vendor's current pricing page, flagging billing basis and vendor-defined prompt units. It does not claim hands-on use of any product, rate data accuracy, or state the unverifiable 1-keyword free plan.

sources.supports: Keywords-not-prompts model; 11 listed engines; $79/month with 'Limited time only'; at-least-weekly keyword refresh; FAQ on buying more than 50 keywords; CSV/API.
$79/month, 7-day trial, 500 prompts, weekly reports, unlimited projects and team members, CSV and API.
Lite $29/month, 15 search prompts, four engines (ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Copilot), Claude/AI Mode/Gemini add-ons, daily tracking; Standard $189 with 100 prompts.
Starter $95/month (monthly), 50 prompts, choose 3 models, daily tracking, 4,500 monthly AI answers defined as prompts x models x frequency; Claude and Perplexity listed only under Enterprise.

Starter EUR 99/month monthly billing, EUR 79/month billed yearly (EUR 948), 500 keywords, 50 AI prompts tracked daily, engines incl. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, AI Mode, AI Overview; 14-day trial no card.
Free Essential with $25 credit (300 credits); Starter $295/month with 3,600 credits and 11 models incl. Claude.
Brands: free 7-day trial (50 prompts daily; ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overviews) and custom Enterprise via demo with up to nine engines.
Definition of GEO, also called AEO.
